attribution_note: Every sentence below is what the operator publishes about itself, quoted with the date it was read. This app does not verify licences.
cannot_verify_notice: This app does not verify licences. Everything in this section is what the operator publishes about itself, quoted with the date it was read.
California requires a guide licence (Fish and Game Code § 2536) for paid hunting and fishing guides, and CDFW publishes a lookup you can check yourself.
California requires a Commercial Passenger Fishing Vessel licence (Fish and Game Code § 7920) for a boat that takes paying anglers, and CDFW publishes no public list of licensed vessels.
A charter captain's U.S. Coast Guard credential can only be verified with the mariner's own reference number.
incompleteness_sentence: This list is the operators this app was able to read from their own published pages. It is not a list of the operators near you.
sort_key_as_printed: Listed by distance from the place above, then by name. This app does not rank operators.
not_affiliated: This app is not affiliated with CDFW or the State of California.
link_only_reason: This app has not read this operator's own pages. Everything here is what the directory published: the name, the location and the link.
unbound_reason: Listed by name. This app could not resolve a home port for this operator from the operator's own words.
species_not_taken: This app took no species from any operator page: the only place these pages name a species is a catch report, and this app publishes no catch reports.
port_binding_rule: An operator binds to places in this app only through the home port it states on its own page. This app reads that port from a quote it holds from that page, matches the port to a tide station whose own published name carries the port as a whole name segment, and binds the operator to the coastal places within 25 kilometres of that station's published position. No address is turned into a coordinate, no operator is given a position of its own, and a port that names two stations or none binds to nothing. An operator whose own pages this app has not read states no home port here and is listed by name.

guide_lookup.guide_lookup_sentence: CDFW publishes a lookup for licensed hunting and fishing guides. This app does not list hunting guides, and it does not check the lookup for anyone.
guide_lookup.no_cpfv_list_sentence: There is no public list of licensed Commercial Passenger Fishing Vessels in California, so every charter statement in this app is the operator's own.

statutes.verbatim: It is unlawful for any person to engage in the business of guiding or packing, or to act as a guide for any consideration or compensation whatever, without first having secured a guide license from the department.
